title: An A-basis section that trivializes the generic fibre
statement: Let A be a valuation domain with fraction field K, let f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}(A) be proper, flat and of finite presentation [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], and let L be an invertible module on X [def-sc-invertible-module]. Suppose that the canonical map K\to\Gamma(X_K,\mathcal O_{X_K}) is an isomorphism and that the tensor pullback L_K is trivial [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then there is s\in\Gamma(X,L) for which a\mapsto a s is a bijection A\to\Gamma(X,L), where A acts through A=\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}(A),\mathcal O)\to\Gamma(X,\mathcal O_X), and the zero ideal sheaf of s [def-pc-zero-scheme] pulls back to the unit ideal sheaf on X_K. No closed-fibre integrality is assumed.

proof.text: Use finitePresentation_moduleCohomology_zero_of_valuationRing and the degree-zero right-derived-functor isomorphism to make the actual section module, with scalars restricted along the structural map, finitely presented.

The proved injective_smul_sections_of_flat kills its torsion submodule. Since A is a valuation domain, Mathlib flat_iff_torsion_eq_bot_of_isBezout and free_of_flat_of_isLocalRing make this finite module free. Choose its finite basis b.

Apply the normalized fraction-field section comparison and map b.baseChange K along it, obtaining a K-basis bK of generic sections. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies tensor and categorical pullbacks. The given generic trivialization and canonical global-function isomorphism give a K-linear isomorphism K to the generic sections. Their finrank is one, so Basis.nonempty_unique_index_of_finrank_eq_one makes the index unique. Its sole section s satisfies the A-bijection by b.repr and b.sum_repr.

Normalization identifies bK(i) with the adjunction-unit image of s. It is nonzero; under the generic trivialization its coefficient is a nonzero field scalar, hence a unit. Thus it is a free generator on the generic fibre. Naturality of the pullback unit shows the pulled-back homOfGlobalSection sends a free generator of the pulled-back unit module to this section. On each affine open its zero ideal is span{1}=top by Hom.ideal_zeroLocus. Hom.comap_zeroLocus and IdealSheafData.ext give the required equality.

proof_origin.place: General-case proof through the rank-one generator; Y2 formalizes finite-free/rank-one and the generic zero ideal, reducing only the normalized degree-zero base-change bridge.

mathlib_searches.query: Global sections of an invertible sheaf on a proper flat scheme over a valuation ring form a free rank one module if the generic fibre is trivial with only constant functions
Global sections of a generically trivial invertible sheaf on a proper flat scheme over a valuation ring have a single basis section that trivializes the generic fibre

lean.statement:
theorem exists_generic_trivializing_generator
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [ValuationRing A]
    (K : Type u) [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of A))
    [IsProper f] [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    (hglobal : IsIso (pullback.snd f (Spec.map
      (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K)))).appTop)
    (htriv : Nonempty ((tensorPullback
      (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K))))).obj L ≅
      SheafOfModules.unit _)) :
    ∃ s : Γ(L, ⊤),
      Function.Bijective (fun a : A ↦
        ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of A)).inv ≫ f.appTop).hom a • s) ∧
      (Hom.zeroLocus (homOfGlobalSection L s)).comap
        (pullback.fst f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap A K)))) = ⊤
